units.source_text: 我像任何学校的新生一样，每天都是带着新鲜的心情上学，但内心总涌上一股漫无边际的思绪。

en.t: Like any new student at any school, I went to school every day with a fresh feeling, but inside me an endless flood of thoughts always welled up.

units.source_text: 我熟悉的，只有鹤川一人，谈得投机的，也只有鹤川一人。

en.t: The only person I knew well was Tsurukawa, and the only person I could really talk with was Tsurukawa too.

units.source_text: 连鹤川本人似乎也感到这样下去，我们就会失去难得来到这个新世界的意义。

en.t: Even Tsurukawa himself seemed to feel that if things went on like this, we would lose the meaning of having come, so rarely and with such effort, into this new world.

units.source_text: 几天后，休息的时间，我们两人特意分开，各自试图开拓新的朋友。

en.t: A few days later, during a break, the two of us deliberately split up, each trying to make new friends.

units.source_text: 然而，结巴的我却连这种勇气也没有，因此随着鹤川的朋友不断增加，我就愈发变得孤独了。

en.t: But as a stutterer, I did not even have that much courage, and so as Tsurukawa gained more and more friends, I became increasingly lonely.
